'''Renishi''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Renishi tasked a Republic-aligned spacer to help the Jawas take back their home from the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]].
